_README: REPRESENTATIVE FIXTURE, not a measurement of any candidate this repository builds. commander_keys lists BOTH the synthetic id the fixture corpus assigns to Kinnan and his real mtg_v1 oracle_id (8d11aa49-...), so the same fixture attaches in offline and live modes without being duplicated. The probabilities are commander_simulator's published figures for its own authored list (STATE.md, 60,000 games, list A snapshot 2026-09-01). They are reproduced here so the consumer path has a realistic shape to develop against. candidate.deck_sha256 is REWRITTEN to the submitted candidate's hash on load and the simulator_version is prefixed 'fixture:', so nothing renders this as a live run. simulation_input_sha256 is likewise a placeholder: this fixture is not the output of any real execution context, and a plausible-looking fingerprint here would be a lie a cache could act on.

metric.measures: turns until a declared pattern is assembled, playing alone with no opponents, no stack, no combat and no interaction
metric.does_not_measure: deck strength, win rate, or card quality

declared_table_assumptions: Three opponents and a WUBRG table are declared as card-text context only.
The model is on the play and keeps its opening seven without mulligans.
known_blind_spots: Summoning sickness and the legend rule are not modelled.
Hullbreaker Horror is filed inert and the classification is a misread by the simulator's author, left in place deliberately and reported rather than silently corrected.

unsupported_assumptions.detail: No opponents are simulated; table fields are declared card-text context only.
The stack, priority, responses, and live interaction are unsupported.

A declared assembly state ends a game; it is not a demonstrated win.
Only explicitly authored effects execute; unlisted cards are reported unauthored.
